messages:
anita.k: Heads up — noticed staging canary toggles from Access Proxy weren't showing up in audit-log for a subset of users after RBAC v2 rollout. Anyone else? @elaine.s @sam.d

deploy-bot: Deploy finished: canary-access-proxy-v2 (deploy_id: d-8891) :rocket:

sam.d: I saw gaps too; can you paste repro steps?

anita.k: Repro:
1) curl -X POST https://staging-proxy.internal/api/feature/toggle -H "Authorization: Bearer ${TOKEN}" -H "X-Canary: true" -d '{"name":"staging_ui_canary","enabled":true}'
2) Check /audit/events for entries

sam.d: thx

elaine.s: Is the audit-log ingested from the proxy forwarder or from control-plane? We rotated the KMS envelope format last week — could break signature parsing.

rick.ops: Proxy pushes to s3-forwarder -> audit-ingest. Audit service validates KMS envelope. If decrypt fails the event is dropped. I'll tail the forwarder.

sam.d: FYI RBAC v2 renamed permission 'canary.toggle' -> 'feature.toggle.canary'. Authz middleware still maps entitlement->audit principal using old key. Could be mismatch.

anita.k: I can reproduce: requests with token containing claim 'features' (new claim) don't produce audit events; tokens with 'entitlements' do. Logs show "audit_event dropped: missing principal" and "principal_mapper: no mapping for claim 'features'".

security-bot: Created INF-9142: "staging audit gaps for proxy authz"; priority=P1 if affecting prod. @elaine.s assigned? :warning:

elaine.s: Assigning to me. Triage plan: check forwarder decode logs for kms:Decrypt failures, then audit-service principal mapper. If KMS rotation broke envelopes, re-run decrypt test with new key material.

rick.ops: Plan: push a temporary shim in audit-service that maps 'features' -> 'entitlements' for 48h, and emit metric 'audit.dropped' when mapping fails.

sam.d: Add unit test for principal extraction, and an alert if audit.dropped rate > 0.1% over 1m.

anita.k: Thanks — leaving detailed repro + sample tokens in INF-9142. @rick.ops please post patch + rollout steps when ready. :thumbsup:
